minimumRequiredArchitecture.step1_schemaExtension: Extend UserEntity & /users/{userId} schema with status ('PENDING_APPROVAL' | 'ACTIVE' | 'REJECTED'), requestedRole, requestReason, approvedBy, and approvedAt.
minimumRequiredArchitecture.step2_postLoginHook: Update authContext.tsx to query /users/{uid} on Google Sign-In and auto-create a document with status='PENDING_APPROVAL' if not found.
minimumRequiredArchitecture.step3_accessGate: Implement a PendingApprovalGuard component in App.tsx that blocks operational views and presents a pending request state for non-ACTIVE users.
minimumRequiredArchitecture.step4_adminApprovalQueue: Add a Pending Account Requests queue in AdminConsoleView.tsx allowing Admins to approve requests, assign roles, and allocate project IDs.
minimumRequiredArchitecture.step5_firestoreRulesGate: Update firestore.rules to require get(/users/$(request.auth.uid)).data.status == 'ACTIVE' for reading/writing operational documents.
minimumRequiredArchitecture.step6_expressTokenVerification: Update authenticateUser in Express backend to verify Firebase ID Tokens and resolve role/status/projects from Firestore rather than relying on request headers.
